rows.claim: D-479: under a proposal p a step over distance r takes r/N with N = ⌈r / min(p, h_max)⌉
rows.evidence: src/model.jl:877-881 `cap = max(min(proposal, h_max), h_min)`, N = max(1, min(ceil((r - slack)/cap), floor_steps)), floor_steps = ⌊r/h_min⌋
rows.fix: Under a proposal `p`, a step over the distance `r` takes `r / N`, with `N = ⌈r / max(min(p, h_max), h_min)⌉`, at least 1 and capped at `⌊r / h_min⌋`.
rows.note: The floor comes from D-460 (log.md:19727), an earlier entry, so nothing later moves it. D-479 is a notation entry and its formula drops the h_min clamp and cap; it differs only when p < h_min or near the floor.

Every § cited (§3.1–§3.4, §4.3, §5.2, §6.1, §7.1, §7.3, §8.1, §8.2, §8.5, §8.6, §9.5, §12.7, §14.1, §14.3, §14.4) exists in spec.md.

They were renamed forward by D-220, D-267, D-279, D-303, D-314 and D-405 (fragment → set, and its `u` keyword survives, probe:106). They are ok, except where the old name carries a rule the code no longer follows: local_types (L6b-016, L6b-025, D-165), localize (L6b-020, D-179), auto-publication (L6b-008, D-252). StopFaceInvalid → L6b-098 (drift, D-316). TierSignatureMismatch at D-249 → L6b-087 (drift, D-263); at D-263 it is ok as the retirement (L6b-121). StoreNotNamedTuple → ok, stated retired (L6b-204). Δt_unit → ok: the code names it `unit` in src/deployment.jl:153 and spells it Δt_unit in comments and src/show.jl.

Pattern: many early ratified entries (D-016, D-033, D-034, D-036, D-045, D-112, D-154, D-195, D-249, D-263, D-279) carry clauses that later entries moved, with no superseded status or annotation on them. D-020 shows the annotation form (log.md:921). Each drift row's fix is phrased as such an annotation, because the log is not rewritten. The one deviation, L6b-234, is D-479's proposal step-count formula: it leaves out D-460's h_min clamp and cap, so it is incomplete rather than contradicted. D-123's glossary claims (146 entries, ten groups) are about docs, not code. They are counted as ptr and not checked.
